content.title: The Masters TV Schedule
content.text: See how to watch or stream every moment from Augusta National Golf Club with the 2026 Masters TV schedule on CBS, ESPN, ESPN+, Paramount+, Prime Video, Masters Live and the CBS Sports app. TV coverage will again be available on CBS and ESPN, with featured holes, featured groups and Amen Corner available to stream on Masters Live, ESPN+ or Paramount+. New in 2026, Prime Video will offer early-round coverage of the first and second rounds at 1:00 PM ET, leading into ESPN’s traditional window at 3:00 PM. If you purchase a subscription through a link on this page, this site may receive a commission. 1:00 amLive From the MastersGolf Channel How to stream the Masters on ESPN+ and Masters Live ESPN+, Paramount+, CBS Sports Digital and Masters Live will carry live streaming coverage of Featured Groups, Amen Corner and Holes 15 and 16 throughout the tournament. ESPN+ and Masters Live will also have streaming coverage of holes 4, 5 and 6. The Masters Live streaming service is available for free through the Masters official website — available here. CBS TV coverage of the Masters can be streamed without cable/satellite authentication through Paramount+ and CBSSports.com. ESPN TV coverage can be streamed through the ESPN app, though that will require authentication. In addition, you can stream the full Masters schedule on linear TV through the following streaming services: Fubo, DIRECTV STREAM, YouTube TV and Hulu + Live TV.
